owner: owner instruction 'Procedi' (2026-10-20) on Claude's proposal after the owner's S94 review (verbatim research in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-research-s94-vectors-qualities-2026-10-20.md): give concepts an explicit I-ADOPT structure (object, quantity, conditions) linked to the property definitions; then test multi-view vector retrieval with a symbolic second-stage re-ranking (BLINK principle) on a new reference; no new dependencies
writtenBefore: any S95 code, any new reference, any score
question: Do explicit multi-view concept representations (MultiKE: name, attributes, relations), derived from PEE's existing scientific knowledge, (a) retrieve the right concept at least as well as PPMI and (b) let a symbolic second stage separate identity from relatedness better than the lexical identifier and the S94 hybrid, without promoting related or different-object concepts?

views.name: concept name and aliases (PPMI)
views.description: first sentence of the concept statement (PPMI)
views.quantity: quantity kinds and metrics typed by the quantity knowledge (QK); disjoint typing is a clash
views.object: name words that are not quantity words: the object of interest and its constraints (I-ADOPT)
views.conditions: condition axes and values typed by QK in the statement
views.relations: graph neighbours and relation kinds (OWL2Vec* depth one)
views.property: the property definitions the concept names, with their object nouns; two different defined properties of one kind are a clash

retrieval: multi-view score: the unweighted mean of the available view similarities, fixed before any run; top-k candidates
rerank: symbolic second stage: no quantity clash, no property clash, no different object; an anchor (alias, shared name word, or matching object term); the best surviving candidate with a margin. Vector similarity never decides identity alone

arms.MV-noviews: ablation: name and description views only
arms.MV-norerank: ablation: multi-view top-1 when it leads by the margin, no symbolic checks

development: the four examined references (R3 dev, held-out, S76 transfer, S94): spent. At most three reformulations, then freeze
independentCheck: a NEW blind reference: 240 never-used mentions (40 per category: televisions, dishwashers, dehumidifiers from the transfer translation; air purifiers, coffee machines, air fryers from the R3 translations), excluding every mention of the four earlier references; candidates pooled from lexical, PPMI and multi-view top 4 plus one control; annotated blind with the unchanged R3 prompt and sealed before any arm runs on it
metrics: retrieval: reference identities among each method's top 5 (pool caveat: an identity no method retrieves is not in the reference)
false identities: related, hierarchical or none promoted
view coverage: concepts with a quantity, object, condition and property view
stopRule: if MV does not recover more identities than the lexical identifier with no more false identities, multi-view identity is recorded as not demonstrated; retrieval is reported separately
